verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Outlook exposes a documented REST API through Microsoft Graph. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on learn.microsoft.com all returned 404. The docs describe endpoints and OData query parameters in prose only, which is not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
